title: Vegetatietypering Voor INBOVEG
text: goal inbovegtypering classify vegetation relevés (plots) predefined vegetation types (syntaxa) based methods described van Tongeren et al. (2008). implements ASSOCIA algorithm supervised clustering.

title: Vegetatietypering Voor INBOVEG
text: can install development version inbovegtypering GitHub :
code: # install.packages("devtools") devtools::install_github("inbo/inbovegtypering")

title: Vegetatietypering Voor INBOVEG
text: core function classify_vegetation() calculates similarity indices vegetation recordings reference synoptic table. indices include: Composite Distance (CoD): primary classification metric combining qualitative quantitative data. (un)Likelihood (-2ln): qualitative distance measure based species presence/absence. Weirdness: Measures presence unexpected species. Incompleteness: Measures absence expected species. Modified Euclidean Distance (MED): quantitative distance measure based species abundance (cover). Note: indices, lower value indicates better match.

title: Vegetatietypering Voor INBOVEG
text: classification process requires two main inputs: Recordings Data: plot data containing species cover values. Synoptic Table: reference table defining vegetation types (syntaxa) species frequencies characteristic cover.

title: Vegetatietypering Voor INBOVEG
text: example uses dummy datasets included package (example_recordings example_synoptics).
